title: Postgres via API: one http page becomes rows that match the run
summary: Submits http (the lab Secure_Shell.html page) -> postgres table e2e_http_page through the API and checks rows equal the records reported, all rows come from one source document with the page URL, and the text mentions SSH.

steps.title: Drop e2e_http_page
steps.explain: Starts clean so every row counted later was written by this run.

steps.title: Submit the job through the API
steps.explain: POST /api/v1/jobs with the TOML base64-encoded, exactly as the console does.

steps.title: Wait for the run to finish
steps.explain: Polls the task result and GET /api/v1/runs until this run reaches a terminal status.

steps.title: Run finished COMPLETED
steps.explain: A clean run must report COMPLETED, not PARTIAL or FAILED.

steps.title: Delivered equals records read
steps.explain: Every record the run read must be reported as delivered to the sink.

steps.title: No record failed
steps.explain: records_failed must be 0 on a clean run.

steps.title: The run read some records
steps.explain: A run that reads nothing proves nothing.

steps.title: Run read one page
steps.explain: An http source reads one URL.

steps.title: Count rows in e2e_http_page
steps.explain: The real number of rows the sink wrote.

steps.title: Rows equal records reported
steps.explain: The table must hold what the run delivered.

steps.title: Count distinct source documents
steps.explain: All rows come from one page.

steps.title: One source document
steps.explain: One page in, one document out.

steps.title: Count rows whose source_uri is the page URL
steps.explain: Provenance must point back to the URL that was read.

args.sql: SELECT count(*) FROM e2e_http_page WHERE source_uri = 'http://127.0.0.1:8765/pages/Secure_Shell.html'

steps.title: Every row carries the page URL
Count rows mentioning SSH
steps.explain: Spot-check that the page text arrived.

args.sql: SELECT count(*) FROM e2e_http_page WHERE text LIKE '%SSH%'
